name: BrowserControl
description: MCP tools exposed by the BrowserControl server.

tools.name: find
tools.signature: find(query: str, role: str | None = None, nth: int = 1)
tools.summary: Search the whole page, including content scrolled out of view, and scroll to a match.
tools.details: Matches visible text and aria-label/placeholder/title/alt/value. With role (e.g. "button", "link", "textbox", "heading", "checkbox"), only elements of that role match, and query filters them by name (may be empty). Returns every match with the element ID it maps to in the new screenshot.

params.name: query
params.description: Text to look for (case-insensitive substring)

params.name: role
params.description: Optional ARIA role to restrict matches to

params.name: nth
params.description: Which match to scroll to, 1-based (default 1)

tools.name: go_back
tools.summary: Navigate back to the previous page.

tools.name: go_forward
tools.summary: Navigate forward to the next page.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.summary: Navigate to a URL. Returns an annotated screenshot with numbered interactive elements.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL to navigate to

tools.name: refresh_page
tools.summary: Refresh the current page.

tools.name: scroll
tools.summary: Scroll the page.

params.name: direction
params.description: "up", "down", "left", or "right"

params.name: amount
params.description:
"small" (100px), "medium" (400px), "large" (800px),
    "page" (full viewport), "top", "bottom", or pixels like "500"

tools.name: act
tools.signature: act(steps: list[dict[str, Any]], stop_on_error: bool = True)
tools.summary: Run several steps in one call and return one screenshot at the end.
tools.details:
Element IDs all refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. A step whose element was removed or replaced (e.g. after navigation) fails as stale, so batch steps on the current page and navigate last.

Each step is an object with "action" plus its fields: {"action": "click"|"double_click"|"right_click"|"hover", "element_id": 3} {"action": "type", "element_id": 4, "text": "hello"} {"action": "select", "element_id": 5, "option": "Canada"} {"action": "check", "element_id": 6, "checked": true} {"action": "drag", "element_id": 7, "target_id": 8} {"action": "press", "key": "Enter"} {"action": "scroll", "direction": "down", "amount": "medium"} {"action": "navigate", "url": "https://example.com"} {"action": "wait", "seconds": 1} {"action": "wait_for", "text": "Saved"} (or "selector")

params.name: steps
params.description: The steps to run in order (at most 25)

params.name: stop_on_error
params.description: Stop at the first failing step (default True)

tools.name: click
tools.summary: Click on an element by its ID number shown in the screenshot.

params.name: element_id
params.description: The number label shown on the element in the screenshot

tools.name: click_at
tools.summary: Click at specific x,y coordinates.

params.name: x
params.description: X coordinate

params.name: y
params.description: Y coordinate

tools.name: double_click
tools.summary: Double-click an element by its ID number (e.g. to open an item or select a word).

params.name: element_id
params.description: The number label shown on the element in the screenshot

tools.name: drag
tools.summary: Drag one element and drop it onto another (sortable lists, kanban cards, sliders).
tools.details: Both IDs come from the same, latest screenshot.

params.name: source_id
params.description: The number label of the element to drag

params.name: target_id
params.description: The number label of the element to drop onto

tools.name: hover
tools.summary: Hover over an element by its ID number.

params.name: element_id
params.description: The number label shown on the element

tools.name: press_key
tools.summary: Press a keyboard key or key combination on the focused element.

params.name: key
params.description:
Key to press (e.g., "Enter", "Tab", "Escape", "ArrowDown", "Backspace"),
 or a combination joined with "+" (e.g., "Control+A", "Shift+Tab",
 "ControlOrMeta+C" for copy on any OS, "Control+Shift+T")

tools.name: right_click
tools.summary: Right-click an element by its ID number to open its context menu.

params.name: element_id
params.description: The number label shown on the element in the screenshot

tools.name: scroll_to_element
tools.summary: Scroll to bring an element into view.

params.name: element_id
params.description: The number label shown on the element

tools.name: type_text
tools.summary: Type text into a text field by its ID number, replacing what it holds.
tools.details: Works on text inputs, textareas, contenteditable regions, and widgets with role=textbox/searchbox/combobox. Checkboxes, buttons, dropdowns and file inputs are refused; use check_checkbox, click, select_option or upload_file.

params.name: element_id
params.description: The number label shown on the element

params.name: text
params.description: Text to type

tools.name: wait
tools.summary: Wait for a specified time (useful for pages with animations or loading).

params.name: seconds
params.description: Time to wait in seconds (default: 1.0)

tools.name: handle_dialog
tools.signature: handle_dialog(accept: bool = True, prompt_text: str | None = None)
tools.summary: Choose how to answer the next JS dialog (alert, confirm, prompt, beforeunload).
tools.details: Call it before the action that opens the dialog. Without it, confirms and prompts are dismissed and alerts acknowledged; either way the next screenshot's text reports the dialog and how it was answered.

params.name: accept
params.description: True to press OK, False to press Cancel

params.name: prompt_text
params.description: Text to enter into a prompt() dialog (only used when accepting)

tools.name: list_downloads
tools.summary: List files downloaded in this session, with where they were saved.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.signature: wait_for(text: str | None = None, selector: str | None = None, state: str = 'visible', network_idle: bool = False, timeout_seconds: float = 10.0)
tools.summary: Wait until a condition holds instead of sleeping a fixed time.
tools.details: Give text, a CSS selector, and/or network_idle. With none, it waits for the page to settle (load, network quiet, DOM quiet). Returns the screenshot either way and says whether the wait timed out.

params.name: text
params.description: Wait for an element containing this text

params.name: selector
params.description: Wait for an element matching this CSS selector

params.name: state
params.description: "visible" (default), "hidden", "attached", or "detached"

params.name: network_idle
params.description: Also wait until no request has been in flight for 500ms

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Give up after this long (default 10)

tools.name: check_checkbox
tools.summary: Check or uncheck a checkbox (or select a radio button) by element ID.
tools.details: Idempotent: it sets the state rather than toggling. Works on inputs hidden under a styled replacement, but refuses one covered by a dialog or banner.

params.name: element_id
params.description: The number label of the checkbox

params.name: check
params.description: True to check, False to uncheck

tools.name: select_option
tools.summary: Select an option from a dropdown by element ID.

params.name: element_id
params.description: The number label of the select element

params.name: option
params.description: The value or visible text of the option to select

tools.name: upload_file
tools.summary: Upload a file to a file input element.

params.name: element_id
params.description: The number label of the file input

params.name: file_path
params.description: The absolute path to the file to upload

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.summary: Get the page content as markdown text.

tools.name: get_page_info
tools.summary: Get current page URL and title.

tools.name: get_text
tools.summary: Get the full, current text of an element by its ID.
tools.details: Reads the live page, so it returns the whole text (not the truncated label from the summary). Form fields return their current value.

params.name: element_id
params.description: The number label of the element

tools.name: run_javascript
tools.summary: Execute JavaScript and return the result.

params.name: script
params.description: JavaScript code to execute

tools.name: screenshot
tools.signature: screenshot(annotate: bool = True, full_page: bool = False)
tools.summary: Take a screenshot of the page.

params.name: annotate
params.description: If True, overlay numbered element markers (default). If False, clean screenshot.

params.name: full_page
params.description: If True, capture the full scrollable page.

tools.name: extract
tools.summary: Extract structured JSON from the page with a selector schema.

params.name: schema
params.description: The fields to extract, as described above

tools.name: extract_links
tools.summary: List the page's links as JSON: text, absolute href, and whether each is visible.

params.name: contains
params.description: Only links whose text or URL contains this (case-insensitive)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of links to return (default 100)

tools.name: extract_table
tools.signature: extract_table(element_id: int | None = None, index: int = 1, output_format: str = 'json')
tools.summary: Extract a table (HTML <table> or ARIA table/grid) as structured data.

params.name: element_id
params.description: An element inside (or containing) the table; omit to pick by index

params.name: index
params.description: Which table on the page, 1-based, when element_id is omitted

params.name: output_format
params.description: "json" (rows keyed by header), "markdown", or "csv"

tools.name: close_tab
tools.summary: Close a specific tab by its index.

params.name: index
params.description: The 0-based index of the tab to close.

tools.name: create_tab
tools.summary: Create a new tab and switch to it.

params.name: url
params.description: Optional URL to open in the new tab.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.summary: List all open tabs with their indices, titles, and URLs.

tools.name: switch_tab
tools.summary: Switch to a specific tab by its index.

params.name: index
params.description: The 0-based index of the tab to switch to.

tools.name: close_session
tools.summary: Close an isolated session and discard its cookies and tabs.

params.name: name
params.description: The session to close (the default session cannot be closed)

tools.name: connect_to_chrome
tools.summary: Attach to your own running Chrome so the agent uses its logged-in sessions.
tools.details: The agent works in a new tab of that Chrome; list_tabs/switch_tab reach the others. Disconnecting never closes your Chrome. Isolated sessions created afterwards open as incognito-like contexts in it.

params.name: cdp_url
params.description: Chrome's remote debugging endpoint (default http://localhost:9222)

tools.name: create_session
tools.signature: create_session(name: str, device: str | None = None, url: str | None = None)
tools.summary: Open an isolated browser session (its own cookies, storage, tabs) and switch to it.
tools.details: Use it to log in as a second user, test signed-out flows, or keep agents apart. The session is in memory only and is lost when closed.

params.name: name
params.description: A name for the session, used by switch_session and close_session

params.name: device
params.description: Optional device to emulate for the whole session (see list_devices)

params.name: url
params.description: Optional URL to open in the session

tools.name: disconnect_chrome
tools.summary: Detach from an attached Chrome (leaving it open) and go back to the managed browser.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.summary: List browser sessions, their tabs, and which one you are using.

tools.name: switch_session
tools.summary: Switch to another session. "default" is the persistent, logged-in profile.

params.name: name
params.description: The session name (see list_sessions)

tools.name: clear_cookies
tools.summary: Clear all cookies.

tools.name: delete_cookie
tools.summary: Delete a cookie by name. Note: This deletes all cookies with this name across all domains in context.

tools.name: get_console_logs
tools.summary: Get browser console logs (errors, warnings, info, log messages).

params.name: clear
params.description: If True, clear the captured logs after returning them

tools.name: get_cookies
tools.summary: Get all cookies for the current context.

tools.name: get_network_requests
tools.signature: get_network_requests(num_requests: int | None = None, clear: bool = False)
tools.summary: Get captured network requests (API calls, resources, etc.).
tools.details: Each line starts with a #id; pass it to get_request_details for headers and body.

params.name: num_requests
params.description: Number of recent requests to return. Defaults to 30.

params.name: clear
params.description: If True, clear the captured requests after returning them

tools.name: get_page_errors
tools.summary: Get JavaScript errors that occurred on the page.

tools.name: get_page_performance
tools.summary: Get page performance metrics (load time, Core Web Vitals).

tools.name: inspect_element
tools.summary: Inspect an element to get its computed styles, dimensions, and properties.

params.name: element_id
params.description: The number label of the element to inspect

tools.name: run_in_console
tools.summary: Execute JavaScript code in the browser console and return the result. Useful for debugging, inspecting variables, or manipulating the page.

params.name: code
params.description: JavaScript code to execute in the console

tools.name: set_cookie
tools.signature: set_cookie(name: str, value: str, domain: str | None = None, path: str = '/')
tools.summary: Set a cookie.

params.name: name
params.description: Cookie name

params.name: value
params.description: Cookie value

params.name: domain
params.description: Cookie domain (optional, defaults to current page domain)

params.name: path
params.description: Cookie path (default: "/")

tools.name: set_viewport
tools.summary: Set the browser viewport size.

params.name: width
params.description: Width in pixels

params.name: height
params.description: Height in pixels

tools.name: clear_mocks
tools.summary: Remove request mocks so requests reach the network again.

params.name: url_pattern
params.description: The pattern given to mock_route; omit to remove every mock

tools.name: export_har
tools.summary: Save the captured network traffic (last 100 requests) as a HAR file.
tools.details: Open it in Chrome DevTools (Network > Import) or any HAR viewer.

params.name: name
params.description: File name without extension (default: timestamp)

params.name: include_bodies
params.description: Also save response bodies (up to 1MB each)

tools.name: get_request_details
tools.summary: Show one captured request in full: headers, POST data, response headers and body.

params.name: request_id
params.description: The #id shown by get_network_requests or wait_for_response

params.name: include_body
params.description: Include the response body (text, truncated; binary as base64)

tools.name: mock_route
tools.signature: mock_route(url_pattern: str, status: int = 200, body: str = '', content_type: str = 'application/json', headers: dict[str, str] | None = None, abort: bool = False)
tools.summary: Answer matching requests with a canned response, or block them, in every tab.
tools.details: Use it to test error states (status=500), stub an API, or block trackers (abort=True). Replaces any earlier mock with the same pattern.

params.name: url_pattern
params.description: Substring of the URL, a glob like "**/api/users*", or "re:<regex>"

params.name: status
params.description: HTTP status to return (default 200)

params.name: body
params.description: Response body (e.g. a JSON string)

params.name: content_type
params.description: Content-Type of the body (default application/json)

params.name: headers
params.description: Extra response headers

params.name: abort
params.description: Fail matching requests with a network error instead of responding

tools.name: wait_for_response
tools.signature: wait_for_response(url_pattern: str, status: int | None = None, timeout_seconds: float = 10.0)
tools.summary: Wait for a network response whose URL matches, e.g. the API call a click triggered.
tools.details: Responses that arrived during the previous tool call count, so call this right after the action that sends the request.

params.name: url_pattern
params.description: Substring of the URL, a glob like "**/api/save*", or "re:<regex>"

params.name: status
params.description: Only accept this HTTP status

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Give up after this long (default 10)

tools.name: emulate_device
tools.summary: Emulate a phone or tablet's screen size, user agent, and touch input.
tools.details: Pass "none" to go back to the desktop viewport. Pixel ratio and the mobile layout viewport need a new context: use create_session(name, device) for a fully faithful device.

params.name: name
params.description: A device from list_devices(), e.g. "iPhone 13" or "Pixel 7"

tools.name: list_devices
tools.summary: List device names accepted by emulate_device and create_session.

params.name: contains
params.description: Only names containing this (case-insensitive), e.g. "iphone"

tools.name: reset_emulation
tools.summary: Undo all emulation: device, geolocation, timezone, color scheme, and throttling.

tools.name: set_color_scheme
tools.summary: Emulate prefers-color-scheme to check dark or light mode.

params.name: scheme
params.description: "dark", "light", or "no-preference"

tools.name: set_geolocation
tools.signature: set_geolocation(latitude: float, longitude: float, accuracy: float = 10.0)
tools.summary: Report a fake location to sites, and grant them the geolocation permission.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude in degrees, e.g. 51.5074

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude in degrees, e.g. -0.1278

params.name: accuracy
params.description: Accuracy radius in meters (default 10)

tools.name: set_timezone
tools.summary: Make pages see a different timezone (Date, Intl).

params.name: timezone_id
params.description: IANA name such as "America/New_York" or "Asia/Tokyo"; "" resets

tools.name: throttle_network
tools.summary: Slow the network down or take it offline, to test loading and offline states.

params.name: profile
params.description: "slow-3g", "fast-3g", "4g", "offline", or "none" to remove throttling

tools.name: export_test
tools.signature: export_test(name: str = '', language: str = 'python', clear: bool = False)
tools.summary: Turn the actions taken so far into a replayable Playwright test file.
tools.details: Covers navigation, clicks, typing, keys, selects, checkboxes, uploads, drags, scrolls, waits for text, dialog answers, and request mocks, since the session started or since start_recording(). Elements are located by test id, role and name, label, placeholder, text, or CSS, never by SoM IDs. Typed passwords become environment variables. Review before committing.

params.name: name
params.description: Test name and file name (default: timestamp)

params.name: language
params.description: "python" (pytest-playwright) or "typescript" (@playwright/test)

params.name: clear
params.description: Empty the action log afterwards, to start the next test fresh

tools.name: list_recordings
tools.summary: List all saved recordings and snapshots.

tools.name: start_recording
tools.summary: Start recording the browser session as a Playwright trace. The trace will be saved when stop_recording is called. Also restarts the action log, so export_test() afterwards covers exactly this recording.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional name for the recording (default: timestamp)

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.summary: Stop recording and save the session trace.

tools.name: take_snapshot
tools.summary: Take a named snapshot (screenshot + HTML) for later reference.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional name for the snapshot (default: timestamp)
